reviews.title: Do not get for blood pressure readings!
reviews.text:
I downloaded today in hopes to be able to use my phone when I’m out and about. I have a machine at home that I use. I have been using both at the same time throughout the day. My regular one say I’m high (which is  where I’ve been lately) and the one on my phone has said every single time that it’s normal and giving a normal reading. I do not ever have a normal reading. It’s always a little
High. DO NOT TRUST THIS FOR BLOOD PRESSURE READINGS. It’s even saying my heart rate is normal and with my medication I’m taking right now, it’s been kinda low. I DO NOT recommend this app. I will be canceling today.
